evaluation.interpretation: synthetic evaluator used to exercise save, evaluation, promotion, and rollback contracts; not coding or generalization evaluation
evaluation.metric: mean probability mass assigned to correct option B normalized over the four first-token choices A-D
evaluation.negative_control: apply a -20.0 logit bias to B at evaluation time; reject it and verify promoted checkpoint identity remains unchanged
evaluation.promotion_rule: promote only when candidate score is no lower than current incumbent

tasks.question: A hall has 6 sections with 23 chairs each. 31 chairs are removed. How many remain? A) 97 B) 107 C) 117 D) 138
A store receives 8 boxes of 15 cups and breaks 13 cups. How many remain? A) 97 B) 107 C) 117 D) 120
A club orders 9 packs of 18 badges and gives away 32. How many badges remain? A) 120 B) 130 C) 140 D) 162
A gardener plants 12 rows of 11 seeds and removes 22 seeds. How many stay planted? A) 100 B) 110 C) 120 D) 132

hypothesis: Starting from the already committed v1 checkpoint, a fresh v1 rollout can complete the synchronous v2 reference and a real learner SIGKILL recovery with exact adapter/Adam/RNG identity; a queued complete v0 group is rejected at use time after policy v1 is active.

model.architecture: frozen pretrained Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct base plus trainable vocabulary-logit-bias policy adapter
model.training_scope: only the added float32 output-bias parameter is trainable; pretrained base weights remain frozen

optimizer.algorithm: pinned RVL HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer clipped token-level GRPO using VARE group-relative advantages
optimizer.optimizer_state: AdamW state saved and restored as part of every committed checkpoint

preregistered_adaptation: The first Sprint XI run committed v1 but its queued stale cohort had no mixed-reward group and the harness stopped before freshness evaluation. This continuation does not rerun any generated prompt or trajectory. For the admission-only check, use the first complete already persisted queued group regardless of reward variance; do not optimizer-train on that constant group. Use only the original protocol fresh_v1 cohort, verified absent from the failed run, for update v2.
primary_outcomes: synchronous and post-SIGKILL recovered v2 adapter, logical AdamW state, and CPU RNG match exactly
real learner SIGKILL is observed after optimizer application but before durable checkpoint commit; replay from v1 creates one effective recovery commit
zero-lag VARE replay rejects the same queued v0 group that permissive admission accepts

stale_admission.group_selection: first complete task record in the already persisted queued_stale_v0 artifact, regardless of reward variance
stale_admission.naive_control: same replay group sampled with freshness function returning 1.0; admission-only, no optimizer call
stale_admission.reward_vector_observed_in_parent: constant all-zero across all 8 tasks; no training on these rows
stale_admission.version_policy: max policy lag 0; verifier version fixed at 0

stop_rule: Use the original 16 GiB process-tree RSS, 512 MiB swap-growth, 2 GiB emergency RAM, 10 GiB disk and 1200 second caps. Preserve partial evidence; no retries or fresh prompt use if the fresh_v1 cohort lacks a mixed-reward group.

fresh_v1_cohort.question: A farm collects 9 baskets with 16 apples each and uses 24 apples. How many are left? A) 100 B) 120 C) 124 D) 144
A train carries 8 cars with 22 passengers each and 37 passengers leave. How many remain? A) 129 B) 139 C) 149 D) 176
A baker packs 6 trays with 21 cookies each, then gives away 26. How many remain? A) 90 B) 100 C) 110 D) 126
A class has 7 groups of 18 students and 13 students are absent. How many attend? A) 103 B) 113 C) 123 D) 126
A shop has 9 shelves with 17 jars each and sells 28 jars. How many remain? A) 115 B) 125 C) 135 D) 153
A worker sorts 5 stacks of 24 cards and removes 19 damaged cards. How many remain? A) 91 B) 101 C) 111 D) 120
A theatre has 11 rows with 14 seats, and 32 seats are reserved. How many are unreserved? A) 112 B) 122 C) 132 D) 154
A depot loads 7 trucks with 19 parcels each and returns 23 parcels. How many are delivered? A) 100 B) 110 C) 120 D) 133

task_and_sampling.reuse: fresh_v1 task IDs were declared in the parent frozen protocol but absent from the partial run output; all are consumed by this continuation.

verifier.cohort_reuse: All prompt IDs and trajectories are consumed by this single systems experiment.
verifier.response_contract: At most eight generated tokens; reward 1 only when the first non-whitespace response character is the declared option A-D and is followed by end, whitespace, or punctuation.
verifier.rollout_group_selection: For each fixed cohort in order, stop at the first prompt with nonconstant rewards among four samples; otherwise continue up to eight prompts. If a cohort has no mixed group, preserve all generations and stop without the dependent optimizer update.
verifier.system_prompt: Solve the arithmetic question accurately. Follow the requested response format exactly.
verifier.type: synthetic arithmetic multiple-choice action selection; systems workload only

update_and_recovery.comparison: hash adapter bytes, recursive logical AdamW state, CPU RNG
update_and_recovery.fault: SIGKILL process after real GRPO train_step and fsynced optimizer_applied_uncommitted journal record
update_and_recovery.reference: one optimizer update on fresh_v1, no fault
update_and_recovery.resume: reload parent v1 adapter, optimizer, RNG and the exact same persisted fresh_v1 rollout; one committed update
